title: Pennsylvania Small Estate Affidavit (2026): The $10,000 Bank Rule and $50,000 Petition
rank_math_description: Pennsylvania has no small estate affidavit: banks pay up to $10,000 to family, and estates up to $50,000 settle by Orphans' Court petition. Tax included.
pdf_outline: Worksheet: per-bank totals (<= $10,000 for §3101) and remaining personal property toward $50,000
Inheritance tax quick table (0 / 4.5 / 12 / 15%) and REV-1500 due dates
Second PDF pa-small-estate-petition-checklist.pdf: Rule 5.50 contents and five exhibits
